title: Long code experiment law
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let a sign tester have a finite seed set equipped with a probability law. The experiment law chooses a vertex uniformly, chooses a seed according to that law, and then independently chooses a uniformly random neighbor of the vertex for every input position of the check selected by the seed; its outcome is the resulting long code experiment sample.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A sign tester with a finite seed set and a probability law
